81622.subject: Binance Hacked for Billions
81622.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* [**Binance**](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-wallet-outflows-widen-to-three-accounts-in-suspected-hack)[ paused withdrawals after a suspected hack](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-wallet-outflows-widen-to-three-accounts-in-suspected-hack)

* [**Polymarket**](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/polymarket-halts-trading-and-pauses-relayer-amid-incident)[ halted trading after a vendor breach](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/polymarket-halts-trading-and-pauses-relayer-amid-incident)

* [**ICE**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ice-plans-us-regulated-hyperliquid-perps-with-tradexyz)[ plans U.S.-regulated Hyperliquid perps](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ice-plans-us-regulated-hyperliquid-perps-with-tradexyz)

* [**Utah**](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/utah-brings-criminal-charges-against-kalshi-and-its-co-founders)[ charged Kalshi and its co-founders](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/utah-brings-criminal-charges-against-kalshi-and-its-co-founders)

* [**Coinbase**](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/coinbase-beats-q3-transaction-revenue-estimates-as-crypto-gains-lift-profit)[ beat Q3 transaction revenue forecasts](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/coinbase-beats-q3-transaction-revenue-estimates-as-crypto-gains-lift-profit)

Binance paused withdrawals today after billions of dollars in crypto left three of its Ethereum wallets. One analyst puts the total at about $3.5 billion, and Binance has not given a figure. The exchange calls it a [security issue](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-wallet-outflows-widen-to-three-accounts-in-suspected-hack) and says user funds are safe. Founder Changpeng Zhao, who no longer runs Binance, said it appears to be a hack and that Binance will cover the loss.

The transfers ran through one wallet permission. At 4:20 p.m. ET, an [EIP-7702 delegation](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/binance-labeled-wallet-swept-minutes-after-eip-7702-delegation) installed code on the wallet Etherscan labels Binance 14. Three minutes later, an outside address called that code and moved 167,464 ETH and 1.615 billion USDT. The same permission then moved 780 million USDC out of a second Binance wallet.

On Oct. 20 we reported that issuer blacklists [recovered nothing in 60 exploits](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/issuer-blacklists-recovered-nothing-in-60-crypto-exploits-blockaid-finds) this year. Blockaid found a blacklist was available in 16 of them and used in none. Today the issuers acted within the hour. Tether blacklisted the receiving address 37 minutes after the first transfer and says it [froze more than 1.567 billion USDT](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/tether-freezes-971-million-usdt-in-wallet-linked-to-suspected-binance-drain).
